comparison.objective: Seal an IVC cage with its filter top and dock it so two air valves connect; candidate calibrates and locks a gripper opening stop.
comparison.physical_skill: Requires large-part gasket alignment, top seating, bimanual transport, runner engagement, and docking insertion rather than small-tool countertorque.
comparison.success_condition: Scores runner support, top registration, two valve depressions, bottle stability, clearance, and dwell; candidate scores angle tolerance, nut retention, three cycles, drift, and clearance.
comparison.reason: Both finish with functional engagement, but cage sealing and docking test large-part alignment and insertion, not preservation of a threaded adjustment.
